en: Yes, of course. You two just gave me some sudden perspective. Carry on!
Yes.
You aren't clever, Orc. I know everything that goes on. Master holds no secrets from me.
You guys are the worst kept secret ever. Yesterday, a merchant passing through asked me if you two were still a thing.
You know, my very favorite part of a sandwich is the bottom. I love how it soaks up the juice from the meat and catches all the gooey cheese.
You sound rather eager for it, after all.
Ack! Heads up boys, we got company!
Aha!
Alright, we got the loot, and the portal is up. Time to scram.
Well, you bitching about it won't make it go any faster! Just keep a lookout and let me work.
Would you hurry up and get that lock open? I swear I heard something moving downstairs.
You got the chest unlocked? Alright, we'll start loading up the treasure, while he gets the portal up.
Ah! Now, that looks promising.
Alright, well you do what you need to do. I'll hang around here for a while, so just come find me when you're ready.
Come. Entertain me.
Excellent. You may be dull, but at least you are not also stupid.
Forgive me for noticing, but you're looking to get inside, right?
He's still here! Look out!
Hey, you!
Hmm... there's the front door. There must be something that unlocks it nearby.
How uncultured.
I must say, I find you all rather dull.
I will forge a glorious symphony of your pain and blood!

Name's Peregrine, and I'm a burglar. A good one. I planned to loot this place myself, but I got a weird vibe and I thought better of it. You look like you can handle yourself though, so I'll tell you what - let's team up. I'll get you in, and you back me up. We'll split the take, aye?
Now leave. There is nothing else for you here, and I have... activities to prepare.
Oh really? Perhaps you aren't as dull as you seem!
Oh, but it's far too late for warnings, sweet Peregrine. Your friends are already here.
Peregrine, though, oh look at how your eyes sparkle with hate! Hate for me! Exquisite!
Perfect. I'll break in through the upper level and then open the door from the inside. Won't be a hot minute.
Still, it's been a very long time since I've had a decent conversation. I suppose you'll have to do.
Such things I will do with you! I will brew within you a hatred so distilled, so pure, my loins ache at the very thought!
This place is practically begging to be broken into. I could get us up to the balcony from here, no problem.
Tsk. This place is practically begging to be robbed.
Uh oh.
Well, how about it? Ready to break in?
What's this? Someone come to my home without so much as introducing himself?
What? You can't!
You there, dullard. I trust your small ambitions will be satisfied with coin? Take 5000$ and leave. I will be keeping Peregrine, of course.
Alright. Everybody keep your eyes peeled.
Astounding! Can you feel that?
He was a clever man, and a good friend. Perhaps something useful can be found here.
He was the last person I saw before meeting you, in fact. He came to the oubliette and... whatever he did, I suppose, is what spared me from the island's fate.
I don't know what waits within, but whatever it is, we should take it very seriously.
I haven't been able to secure nearly enough blackglass, however, and I don't think that I could find a suitably-skilled craftsman in this social climate. Blast my luck.
I must advise caution. We have no idea what this device is or what its purpose is. Damaging it or even activating it could prove disastrous!
I understand that we have few options, but I have a very bad feeling about this.
If it fails, I suspect that an eternity adrift the sea of stars awaits me. We shall see if I tire of the view. I pray that Maxim renders my efforts unnecessary.
My recommendation is that we begin careful study and experimentation immediately. This is surely important.
The lattice is laid out. All that remains is to assemble the fetish and to weave the proper energy around it.
The veins here are wide open, positively rushing through this room!
There is no more time. I shall have to attempt the ritual shorthanded. If this succeeds, then I hope to strike a bargain with a being great enough to save us.
This is Fastad's private study. I was here only once before.
This is important! Whoever this Fastad was, he began something here, something that has waited out the centuries for you to find it.
This place has a familiar odour. I suspect that whatever its purpose, it draws at least some of its energy from the powers of hell.
This place!
Whatever this is, it's meant to channel an incredible magnitude of power, and the veins have been cultivated to provide it.
You are surely powerful enough to manage this, whatever its purpose. Seize this too, and turn it to your glory!
Ferris Market Tavern. Open mornings and afternoons - all welcome!
My contract here has long expired, and I am no longer compelled by mortal writ to consume the dead.
No, this time, I shall sample the succulent pain of the still-living! Come, morsels, dress yourselves in agony! My feast awaits!
Please do not climb the fence.
Repeat offenders will undergo corporal punishment. Resisting arrest, or demonstrating any degree of violence, is punishable by death.
Restricted access.
Those caught stealing, practising magic, or selling hazardous substances and explosives within the town walls shall face immediate public execution.
Those caught trading on Market Street after dusk, or without a valid permit, shall have their assets confiscated and will be imprisoned for an undisclosed amount of time.
Visiting hours are currently suspended.
Welcome to Ferris Market Town Hall. Please inquire inside for trading permits.
You come and offer me violence, but you know nothing of violence.
Come with me.
So this is it. Time to get off this rock and never come back.
Something happen on the way, did it? We can't leave without twenty strong, so find replacements for your casualties, and don't keep me waiting.
...they mentioned something about selling me as a concubine.
...they want to sell me to a gorgon.
Agreed.
And I swear, if Kirilo gets to see Shapiro's goods before I do, I'm gonna kick his green ass too.
And I wager you've a warmer embrace than the gorgon I'm to be sold to.
Are you guys alright?
Bloody poison!
Crap.
Do you think we're gonna die here, Ro?
Gah! God damned insects.
Hey, just because I want to see everybody's smuggled goods doesn't mean my ideas are bad!
Hmm. Not bad. If the inside is holding up as well as the outside, it should be a decent shelter.
Hopefully the boss got your message.
I am so lonely. Afore this marriage, I could at least convince a wench to warm my bed with a few coins, but now even that is gone and my bed is cold indeed.
I can barely even hear you over the throbbing of this headache.
I could use a little heat right now. This place is freezing.
I don't hear anything. An animal perhaps?
I don't know. Perhaps I did.
I don't suppose you guys want to give my friends back?
I don't... have much time. I can barely... project this image... and I ... cannot hear you, so please... listen closely.
I have definitely been better.
I heard it.
I was the one who kept downplaying the possibility. I was tired and didn't want to think about it.
I wasn't naked on a dungeon floor an hour or two ago.
I'd rather be a concubine than a labourer.
I'll take that as a no then.
I'm sure you're just being paranoid. It was a hart or some harmless beast, and soon we'll-
I'm well-ready for a rest. It's far too hot today.
I've got a bad feeling about this, Ro.
If he was at the house, he did, but for all we know he got captured too and is in another cell.
If she was at the house, she did, but for all we know she got captured too and is in another cell.
If we aren't rescued soon, I may have little choice.
Kirilo, lad. Help me walk, will you?
Kirilo... I can't... move...
Let's get you guys out of here. You can recuperate somewhere warmer and drier.
Maybe she, at least, will find some joy when I am gone, in the arms of a man with a smoother face.
Maybe. We'd better do a quick sweep to make sure.
Much as I'd like to be indigniant, Kirilo is right, and it's been getting worse. I can scarcely see straight, let alone conjure.
No rest just yet, it seems.
No. I could understand most of what they were saying. They were sizing us up for our value as slaves.
Noctum!
Now you sound like Peregrine.
Of course.
Peregrine! Focus!
Peregrine! Keep your voice down! What if there are guards in there?
Right behind you, Ro.
Shapiro, that's not an insect, it's a dart!
Shapiro? Is that you?!
Slaves?
So far, so good.
So it was you making all that noise! I knew you'd come for us!
So repulsed by me is my wife that she sleeps in a separate room, the room I built for the children I now know we will never have.
Spoke too soon.
Surely even Peregrine has a good idea once in a while.
That doesn't mean it was your fault. We just got caught in a bad situation, that's all.
That, I promise.
Then we'll kick their asses like we always do.
They drugged us with some kind of paralytic poison. The feeling is starting to come back to my limbs, but poor Ro here has been having a rough time.
They've been gone far too long. I don't like this.
Try to stay positive. He'll come for us.
Try to stay positive. She'll come for us.
Unless he shows me his goods too. Then we're cool.
Wait, did you guys hear that?
Wait, so you did that to take heat off me?
We shall see.
Well, if I didn't take responsibility for it, you would have. What difference does it make?
Well, my boy, shall we?
Why did you say it was your fault that we got captured?
Yeah, yeah.
Yeah. Probably nothing.
Yes. They think you'll make a good labourer, and they...
You can huddle with me if you need to, Ro.
You two go that way, and we'll go around the back. Meet back here in a few minutes.
You were just complaining about the heat an hour or two ago.
...we're never that lucky, are we?
If we're lucky it will just be abandoned and we can move on, but...
It's another prison, and I can't imagine this place is any better than the rest.
Might want to be careful here.
Ugh, gross. This place smells like gnolls. Keep an eye out.
Well that's a weird smell. Almost like a werewolf, but with an extra dose of sick ass.
... will one of you guys piss on that for me? It'd mean a lot to me.
... yeah, okay. I know it's weird. Whatever.
Alright, nearly there. Just through here and hang a right. I hope you're ready.
An assassination? Don't make me laugh! Have you any idea how many fools have failed to assassinate me?
Anyway, we took care of Frico. Just gotta find that key he dropped, and we can get through Westgate. What are we waiting for?
Byrne. Did you think I'd sent you out to enjoy a vacation? You were given a task and I expected you to accomplish it in a timely manner!
Come down here and say that to my face, corpse! I'll show you my blunt fangs!
Come, little pup, and fetch the reward you've earned for gnashing at your master's hand!
Do you think I care how you feel? You are nothing.
Do you think this is even a contest? That I am playing some game with you?
Enough baying, hound!
For years, you've blamed your savagery on us! I've seen the caravans, and how you go out of your way to make it look like a werewolf attack.
Frico is going to try to kill you. You know that, right?
Fuck, that was disgusting.
Generally, passage is reserved for merchants. They bring trade and wealth to my lands, and in return, I give them use of the safest roads, so they may skirt the dangers of... less-travelled routes.
Gold well-spent, I assure you. Here is your key.
He doesn't give a shit about trade or passage or whatever. He eats the good ones and the poor ones, and the ones that get through are the ones with bad blood and money.
He's finally fucking dead. I'm free.
Here we are. Up we go.
Hmm. Hold on.
Hold on for a minute.
Hold on. I think I smell something. Might be another way in. If it is, we can get inside without using the main gate, maybe get the drop on old Fucko.
How dare you!
I can't smell anything but rot. We'll have to look around, I guess. Best get to it.
I do not make exceptions for misers! You approached me under the pretense of trade, so I will draw my due from you, one way or another!
I do not make exceptions for paupers! If you cannot pay in gold, I will draw my due from you in blood!
I hate YOU Frico!
I hate vampires! I hate your stupid fucking court and your stupid fucking blood parties!
I hate your hands and your fucking teeth on my skin, I hate all the stupid shit you make me do!
I have gifted you with life eternal, and this is how you repay me? With treachery?!
I owe you an awful lot, and I've never liked this castle anyway, so if you'll have me, I'm staying on. Whatever you're up to, I'm in it with you.
I shall inform him of your arrival at once. Please, do come in.
I trust this will be a profitable arrangement for the both of us. It has been a pleasure doing business with you.
I will sweeten the draught of your blood by drawing it from you slowly, and with much pain! Your penance for this insult is nigh!
I've seen the dead eyes peering at us from the shadows, the grinning fangs when one of us falls to your traps.
I've seen the missives that forbid merchants from trading with us, penned in your cold hand.
If I am a pawn, then move me aside, leech! Show me your fangs so I can pull them out!
Instead you're a sad waste of loose skin and blunt fangs. It offends me to even sully my gaze upon you.
Look at you.
Look, I'm saying if you're serious about getting through that gate, you're going to have to be ready to fight him. Don't let him convince you of anything else.
Looks like we're in the kitchen. With any luck, we've managed to get in unnoticed. So far so good.
My people suffer because of you Frico, and today, I'm going to be the one to put you down!
Not too bad for a useless waste of skin, huh?
Now that our business is concluded, please make yourselves at home in my court. When you are ready to leave, speak with me and I will have someone escort you outside.
Now we just have to track down Frico and put a sword in him. Let's go.
Now, leave. I tire of the sight of you.
Restrain them and bring them before me.
Shit. I was hoping he'd still have a head, so I could take it home. Even his fangs are gone.
Shut the fuck up, you rotten corpse! I didn't ask for this!
Still, it seems you've brought me something interesting. Let's have a look, shall we?
Still, the boldness does impart a certain richness to one's blood. I will enjoy draining you of it!
Stupid mongrel, your people are nothing but pawns to move as I direct!
Surely you seek passage to the east, yes? That is, after all, why anyone comes to this court.
Surprise guests? And one of them has a fierce heart indeed!
Take care you do not lose it, for I am not fond of giving second chances to incompetents.
Thanks. Even if you don't really mean it, it's not something I ever get to hear. It's nice.
That's the closest thing to joy I felt since being turned. Thank you.
The cost of safety is 10,000$, squarely. Pay this, and Westgate shall be open to you, along with the eastern half of Lukatt.
The mongrel's bark betrays its nature. What a woeful waste of the primal blood coursing through you.
The price you may find steep, but in the interest of... fairness... it must be the same for all travellers. You understand, of course.
This has been a long time coming, Frico!
This way.
Ugh, finally. I can climb this no problem. Let me go first and I'll help you up.
Ugh, fuck, it's some kind of... charnel pit or something. I can barely breathe.
Wait. There's a lot of... red tape, if we go in through the main door. Let's go in through my entrance instead. Skip the wait and take you straight to the boss.
Watch your step. And try to keep your voices down.
Welcome, honoured guests, to my humble abode. It is rare we have visitors at all, and rarer still to have ones as obviously well-travelled as you.
Welcome. You have come to seek audience with Lord Frico, have you not?
Well, at least the soft-skinned pup wants not for bravado! Brains, on the other hand, he sorely lacks.
What a weird feeling. I want to cry, but vampires don't cry. I want to piss on his corpse, but vampires don't piss either.
Yeah, funny, huh? It's kind of great still having a heartbeat. Not that you ever had one to start with.
Yeah. Ha ha, right?
You do not deserve the blood you boast! Give it hence!
You freed me, and you should be able to get through the gate now.
You should be a paragon of brutal, primal physicality, a sculpture of muscle and flesh, chiseled to perfection by moonlight!
You've left your key on the floor, fool.
You, dog, do not make demands of me!

Madam Johan, if you are reading this, you may consider your outstanding debt paid in full. -B
You bastard, Regar, this was only half the payment promised. If you value your pretty little face, you'll have the rest of the payment next time we meet.
All of these graves lie empty. This one, at least, I know why, but I will never know what became of all my cousins.
Beauregard, are you alright?
Before I go, there is something I must ask of you. Another shared my burden, and unlike me, he was guiltless.
DLRO
ERAU
Enough dwelling. I am ready to quit this place.
Glamig. My cousin. My Queen.
I am not. Let us finish what we need to do here and begone.
Lingun Cosova, Duchess of Babe
Luc Beauregard
Phara Cosova, Queen Mother

Please, stranger, if you would do me this one last honour, take the crown from my body and visit Blackspire Oubliette, learn what became of my cousin, and if his spirit suffers still, cut him free, as you have cut me free. His duty is long finished.
QSSI
Ryke Tsarath, Duke of Knavewood
Shur bree ah! Id shur bree ah! Dum ay, dum ay Id shur bree ah!
Shur bree ah. Dum ay or pen d'Id shur bree ah.
There is more I would say, but I have no time left. My journal may yet remain in the nearby abbey if you would learn more. Now go, and know that you go with my thanks.
